readme_animations.alt: Real experimental 1GGQ OspC dimer rotating as a rigid body. Teal and blue are the two deposited chains; amber marks the separate 8 angstrom C-alpha proximity proxy.
The saved 30 by 218 OspC alignment becomes column summaries while keeping coverage and empirical agreement distinct.
Frozen alignment column 68 maps to Q07337 position 67 and observed 1GGQ A Ser67, with 30 of 30 coverage and 66.7 percent agreement.
Two 100 percent agreement values are supported by 30 of 30 versus one of 30 observations.
The 162 observed C-alpha coordinates of experimental 1GGQ chain A rotate without changing the deposited structure.
